signed_correlation_cluster_robust.interpretation: If the cluster-robust CI excludes zero, the original finding survives proper accounting for non-independent (same-company) observations -- the relationship is real but apparently too unstable in sign/magnitude across time to model, which is itself the honest conclusion. If the CI includes zero, the original p~1e-35 significance was likely inflated by treating correlated rows as independent, which would explain why NO functional form has generalized across 12 attempts: there may be nothing stable there to model in the first place.
